item.title: a small guide to systemd units
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
Short post: systemd units is one of those things that looks simple until it isn’t.

why it matters

Systemd units shows up across linux work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Prefer the obvious solution; clever costs interest forever.
  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.
  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

what works for me

  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.
  • Start with the smallest thing that works, then make it boring on purpose.
  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

item.title: the case for systemd units
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
Every few months systemd units bites me again. This is what finally stuck.

why it matters

Systemd units shows up across linux work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.
  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.
  • Optimise for the reader who shows up six months from now with no context.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
